### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We stand for a future where extraordinary wealth belongs to everyone.

2. We see a future beyond scarcity. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%. Not just a fortunate few. Everyone.

3. We reject the idea that extraordinary wealth must remain the privilege of a few. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now. That is the future we champion.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We mean everyone, not merely those who already own technology, capital or influence. We envision prosperity that reaches every household, every community and every country. We see this future as a decisive break with the assumption that extraordinary wealth must depend on somebody else going without. We champion that transformation because we believe abundance should define the human experience. Our ambition is not simply to raise living standards. We stand for a world where today’s greatest fortunes become tomorrow’s universal baseline.
